en: Think about the peace of Christ.
Tim Keller puts it like this:
A Christian's peace

text:
생각을 *적게* 하는 데서
오는 것이 아니라
en: doesn't come from thinking less

text:
인생의 중요한 문제를
더 많이 더 *깊이*
en: but from thinking more, and more deeply,
about the big questions of life.
It isn't about forgetting.
"This is hard, I'm stressed": trying not to worry
by thinking about something else,
but thinking more deeply.
The peace Paul talks about

text:
근심의 생각을 하지 않는
*부재*에서 오는 것이 아니라
en: doesn't come from the absence of worry
but from a presence.
Into the middle of my most painful anxiety and fear
you invite Christ.
And you keep holding on to that thought
until God's word does its work,
until God's word rises above
the anxiety and fear in our lives.
You have to keep holding on.
If you don't fix your mind there,
the more you pray, the more anxious you get.
Hold on to that thought.
Hold on to it deeply.
